description: Style-aligned optional motion guidance; not a requirement to install Anime.js. Durations are design starting points, not guaranteed runtime values.

reduced_motion.rule: Honor @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce). When active, set duration_ms to 0 and disable all non-essential transforms and translations.

claymorphism.interaction: Pressed button with 1–2% compression and a brief return; keep existing sculpted shading.

glassmorphism.interaction: Short surface opacity/translate transitions for revealing real layers; keep content contrast stable.
glassmorphism.avoid: animating blur radius or continuous glow

brutalism.interaction: Use immediate state flips by default; Anime.js generally unnecessary.
brutalism.avoid: springs, sliding reveals, theatrical scroll animations

neo-brutalism.interaction: Short direct 1–2px button shift with a matching hard-shadow response; never animate giant shadows.

minimalism.interaction: Short opacity or translation feedback only on a meaningful state change.

swiss-editorial.interaction: Precise, restrained underlines or sectional changes that preserve reading flow.
swiss-editorial.avoid: word-by-word autoplay and gratuitous kinetic text

bento.interaction: Animate a tile only when its contents or layout genuinely change; ensure stable reading order.
bento.avoid: every tile animating on initial page load

skeuomorphism.interaction: Believable short travel of a physical control with strong immediate feedback.
skeuomorphism.avoid: slow springs, idle knob movement, decorative sounds

retro-terminal.interaction: Immediate state changes; optional skippable typing demo only when user asks.
retro-terminal.avoid: typing essential instructions and never-ending blinking gimmicks

enterprise.interaction: Minimal immediate feedback, no distracting animation during repeated data work.
enterprise.avoid: staggering tables, moving metrics, and loading delays
